target_policy: frozen Phase 5R2 generic numerical control target; do not recompute or revise
nonphysics_clocks_policy: measurement, outer, PLC, Safety, and actuator periods remain frozen and independent of physics dt

aggregation_rule.feasibility_failed: logical OR across all four training scenarios
aggregation_rule.thermal_tracking_iae: sum temperature_iae_k_s across all four training scenarios
aggregation_rule.control_total_variation: sum control_total_variation across all four training scenarios
aggregation_rule.pump_electrical_energy: sum pump_electrical_j across all four training scenarios

numerical_indistinguishability_rule.candidate_pair_difference: absolute difference between candidate aggregate thermal IAE values at dt=0.05 s
numerical_indistinguishability_rule.uncertainty_bound: abs(candidate_A IAE_0.1 - IAE_0.05) + abs(candidate_B IAE_0.1 - IAE_0.05)
numerical_indistinguishability_rule.effect: thermal IAE cannot rank that pair; apply the next registered criterion using dt=0.05 s aggregates

mesh_ordering_policy.raw_winner: minimum original selection tuple independently at each mesh
mesh_ordering_policy.robust_winner: outer_b at all three meshes with outer_a-minus-outer_b thermal IAE positive at all meshes
mesh_ordering_policy.unstable: raw winner changes across meshes without resolution by the registered indistinguishability and tie-break hierarchy

candidate_convergence_rule: for every candidate, abs(IAE_0.1-IAE_0.05) must not exceed abs(IAE_0.2-IAE_0.1)
forbidden: target, plant, actuator, sensor, Safety, candidate, scenario, event, clock, or selection-policy changes
retuning, new gains, Phase 5.1R2, Phase 6, or feedforward
